_comment: Curated OpenML datasets for the DS agent failure analysis benchmark.
_note: Uses OpenML dataset IDs (did). Target column and task type taken from OpenML metadata where possible, overridden here where needed. All data fetched via openml.datasets.get_dataset(did).
_coverage: Focuses on gaps not covered by STRABLE (regression-heavy) or Kaggle: diverse BC/MC, some regression, activity/signal data.
_api: pip install openml  —  no credentials required for public datasets.
